description: A React component for managing a collection of items with drag-and-drop reordering, addition, and removal functionalities, used within the Superset frontend for explore controls.

classes.name: CollectionControl
classes.description: A React component class for a draggable, editable collection of items with add/remove capabilities.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates the value at a specific index in the collection.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds a new item to the collection using the itemGenerator.

methods.name: onSortEnd
methods.description: Handles reordering of items after drag-and-drop.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item at a specified index.

methods.name: renderList
methods.description: Renders the list of collection items with drag handles and remove buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire collection control component including header and list.
